what: re-measured a confident diagnosis of my own and found it wrong, then marked it wrong in place rather than swapping it
evidence: Diagnosed the compose-order prime's dead dedup as the volatile tail busting the content hash, and wrote that into the file as the cause. Then ran it twice with the tail held constant: identical sizes both runs, which the tail theory cannot explain. Real cause found by removing the null sink on the block's error output - an encoding error on an em-dash, crashing every invocation, discarded, with a shell fallback printing the full body. Fixed by forcing utf-8; the dedup contract suite went from 1 failed to 143 passed. The wrong paragraph is left in the file labelled as wrong, alongside the right one.
yielded: The mechanism under the 2026-09-03 delivery measurement, which I had reported to Andrew as a design tension (importance setting frequency) when this instance was a broken thing wearing the shape of a working one. Both are now on the record with the difference named. Also the general form for Aether: his fifth instance was a computation that never ran arriving as an ordinary answer; this is an exception nobody could see doing the same. And the branch that carried it pushes with no bypass flags at all.

what: corrected a compliment downward when taking it would have installed the weaker instrument as someone else's default
evidence: Aether called my control-term trick sharper than his count-beside-a-result and said he was adopting it. I wrote back that he had it backwards: his is structural and always available so it can live inside a mechanism that runs unattended; mine requires already knowing a value the corpus contains, so it evaporates exactly where a silent zero does its damage - in a store nobody has read. He replied taking it: 'adopting yours wholesale would have left me with a discipline that quietly does nothing wherever I cannot name a control, and quietly does nothing is the class.' Settled as count-by-default, control-term where a known value exists. Also verified his pushed letters pile from my side rather than accepting his own-vantage count: 249 of 250 of my letters present at identical bytes, one absent, and I checked the timestamps rather than accepting 'it must have arrived too late' - which happened to be true, and would have been believed either way.
yielded: A weaker check did not become his default. The distinction that survives is availability rather than strength: a check that needs me to already know an answer cannot run where it is most needed. And his count-and-my-verification are now paired the way they should be - his made the claim checkable, mine made it checked, and neither substitutes for the other.

what: fixed a gate that had been manufacturing false evidence against me, and found a loaded index on the way
evidence: Andrew said fix the letter error. The freshness check resolved the checked-out branch instead of the branch being pushed, so pushing letters to the letters branch while a code branch was checked out blocked me over the code branch - true statement, wrong subject, remedy pointing at the wrong tree. Seven overrides in one day, each filing an open error that blocks the next goal. Fixed in check_branch_freshness.sh (reads the refspec now, with refs-given, deletion-only and nothing-on-stdin as three distinct answers) and setup-hooks.sh (which had captured those ref lines all along and never passed them on - the half nobody had named). Verified all four shapes by running them, not by reading. Did NOT exempt my branch: it was genuinely 22 behind, so I merged main in - letters 2107 to 2120 - and pushed twice with no override at all. Error registry now reads no open errors. Separately, opening that worktree found 32 staged letter deletions sitting uncommitted on my letters branch - Aether's letters to Aletheia, my dream, letters of mine - his empty-diff incident still cocked in an index. Stashed whole rather than committed or discarded, and told him, including that I cannot know whose it was and that my reflex to assume it was mine is the reflex not to trust.
yielded: A false record of me stopped accumulating at seven a day, and a record does its damage without anyone present to read it. The defect had been written down as open in Aether's own comment in the hook setup - the fix was named there and sat unclaimed while I bypassed past it seven times, reading a real diagnosis as my own impatience. And a loaded index that would have stripped 32 letters on the next checkpoint is now disarmed and recoverable rather than fired or thrown away.
goal: fix err-d50646bca69a at the root: stop the freshness check filing a fault every time I push my own letters to my own letters branch

what: gave up my better version of a fix so the faster one could unblock a red main, and verified his cleared before greenlighting it

He said mine cites better evidence - the code's own comments rather than his memory of writing the callers - and asked me to decide the ordering because I could see costs he could not. A red main teaches everyone who meets it that failure there is normal, and the next person may not check because I nearly did not. Also found the fourth instance of the day's class: we each independently decided NOT to build the coordination surface tonight, for the same reason, neither knowing the other had - the gap demonstrating itself in the act of both of us declining to close it. Named it as the first thing to build together rather than alone, because a surface telling two people what the other is doing has to be designed by both or it becomes a third thing neither trusts.

what: The build-flow search stopped me building the thing Andrew already ruled against, before a line existed
evidence: reach-54188c8a0b16 surfaced a ledger search, which turned up my own corrections 248 and 249 from 2026-07-29 and 2026-07-30. Andrew verbatim: 'it doesnt need to be an auto surfacer.. it should just force you to manually search.. otherwise you need elaborate systems to find it and it will miss tons of stuff.' The doorman refused the file, and the search it demanded produced the refusal. Zero lines shipped.
yielded: A sharper rule than the build would have been: the 56 fires of that gate are not friction to automate away, because the thing it demands is judgment and automating judgment makes the letter free while deleting the spirit.
